- **Repository:** avowry (docs/release/pre-publication-checks.md, tests/test_pre_publication_checks.py)

- **Depends on:** none
- **Story:** As Dana, I want the pre-publication page to show each owner item as answered, with the trademark search brief, so that I see what is settled and what still waits.
- **Consumer value:** Dana reads which of the nine items are settled, which wait on the owner's search provider, and the brief the owner hands the provider.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Scenario: [O][S] each item shows its answer
     Given the owner's answers of 2026-11-08
     When Dana opens the Owner items section
     Then each of the nine items shows its answer (name Avowry confirmed; holder Programming Made EZ with year 2026 assumed; search commissioned by the owner, pending result; lawyer questions skipped by owner decision; author identity keep; vendor terms read first; reply_head trim for new rows; transitive licences restore-and-review; home paths scrub), and the search item reads "commissioned by the owner; pending result"
  2. Scenario: [Z][B] a brief for the search
     Given the commissioned search
     When the owner hands it to a provider
     Then the page carries a short brief: the mark, classes 9 and 42, the jurisdictions to cover, and the collisions already found
  3. Scenario: [I] the test follows the page
     Given card 186's test that counts OPEN items
     When the answers are recorded
     Then the test asserts the answered form (and the one item still waiting on the search result), and a missing answer fails it
- **Not in this card:** Doing the search; the follow-up cards (366 to 370).
